This is a state employee (bank employee) receiving bribes. So the crime is 受贿 (bribery) for state officials. Also possibly "单位受贿"? The list includes both "受贿" and "单位受贿". Wait that case: the defendant was a property manager, not a state employee, so they used "非国家工作人员受贿". For state employees, they use "受贿". Also there is "单位受贿" which is for a unit (organization) receiving bribes? Usually "单位受贿" is for a unit (organization) receiving bribes, not an individual. Here it's an individual. So correct label: "受贿". Also maybe "利用职务便利" is typical for "受贿". So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
